notes.title: Gameplay and Balance Improvements
notes.content: This update brings various gameplay improvements, balance adjustments, and bug fixes. We’ve improved combat mechanics, especially regarding special abilities, refined several platforming elements, and implemented minor UI and level layout tweaks (like smoother screen shake) for a better overall experience.

notes.title: Performance
notes.content:
We’ve just released an update focused on improving overall performance and stability.
We’re always listening to your feedback and working to make Bleeding Deities even better.

notes.title: Bleeding Deities Updated!
notes.content:
We want to thank you all for the support since launch. 
Recently, we released a performance improvement update to enhance your gameplay experience.


Now, we want to make Bleeding Deities more accessible to players, so now is a great time to try the game and dive into an adventure offering about 6 to 10 hours of action, depending on how much you explore.



We’re continuing to work on improving the game and bringing you exciting updates.

notes.title: New Patch Available!
notes.content:
A new update has arrived! You can now continue exploring the world of Bleeding Deities after defeating the Teot Deity!

🌀 What's New?
After defeating the Teot Deity, a mysterious portal will appear in the same scene where the boss fight takes place. Entering this portal will return you to the Master’s Portal, allowing you to keep exploring the rest of the tribes, collect any missed collectables, 

⚠️ Important Note:
If you've already defeated the Teot Deity before this update, you'll need to defeat them again for the portal to appear.

🛠️ Coming Soon:
We’re currently working on accessibility options. Stay tuned for more updates!

Thank you to all our players for your continued support, feedback, and passion.

notes.title: 🔧 Important Fix – Access Block Resolved!
notes.content: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and thank everyone who reported the issue. Your feedback helps us improve and ensure a better experience for all players.

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just rolled out a new patch update focused mainly on enhancing overall performance and making a few minor improvements to the user interface We're continuing to listen to your feedback and working behind the scenes to improve the game further.

notes.title: 🛠 Performance Improvement Patch
notes.content:
This small patch focuses on internal optimizations to improve overall game performance and provide a smoother experience. Minor adjustments have also been made to enhance stability.

Thank you for playing and for your continued support!

notes.title: Bleeding Deities is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
The wait is over — Bleeding Deities has officially launched!

Step into a mythological world inspired by ancient Mayan civilization, where divine powers clash, blood fuels the gods, and your skills determine the fate of forgotten realms. This 2D action-adventure blends fast-paced combat, platforming, and exploration in a rich, hand-drawn universe filled with secrets and deadly foes.

🌿 Explore the Tribes and unlock the mysteries of the Baktun Stone.
⚔️ Fight the fierce warriors  and face off against ancient deities.
🌀 Master combat abilities like counter-attacks, dashing, and the sacred boomerang.
🔍 Discover hidden relics,  and powerful upgrades.
🧙‍♂️ Meet key characters like the healer, the artisan, and the master — each with unique roles in your journey.
⚔️Rescue prisoners hidden deep within enemy territory and gain their gratitude.
🐉 Ride a mighty dragon across the skies in epic, story-driven sequences.
🌌 Travel through portals to reach mythical regions, face bosses and uncover a story carved in blood and prophecy.

Whether you’re here for the challenge or the lore, your path starts today.

notes.title: Bleeding Deities Launches April 30th!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re incredibly excited to announce that Bleeding Deities will finally be released on Steam this April 30th!

This is a passion-driven indie project, built with tons of love and dedication. We truly believe it offers a fun and memorable adventure that we can’t wait to share with you.

What’s the game about?
You’ll step into the shoes of a young warrior inspired by Mayan mythology, exploring forgotten lands and battling ancient deities that have corrupted the tribes.
The story has been one of our greatest motivations throughout development, and we truly hope it resonates with you.

Thank you so much for reading — and for being part of this journey.
Your feedback means the world to us!

 Don’t forget to wishlist the game — and get ready for the launch on April 30th!

notes.title: Bleeding Deities Demo now Available!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to invite you to dive into the Bleeding Deities  demo at the upcoming Steam Next Fest!  🛡️⚔️
In the demo, you’ll:
✨ Meet the Healer, Artisan, and Master – the core characters of the story.
✨ Explore the Calm Village and uncover hidden secrets.
✨ Master platforming skills like wall jumps and dashing with an easy tutorial.
✨ Use the boomerang to activate levers and solve puzzles.
✨ Battle powerful enemies using essential combat skills like counter-attacks.
✨ Upgrade your weapons and armor with the Artisan.
